title: 第7章 倔强的唐诗潇第8章 治病
content_zh:
;;
“住口！”唐诗潇面色阴冷，双拳紧握，而且拳风表面有一层薄薄的看似雾气的东西。
唐诗逸马上把陈楚拉了出去。
“陈先生，你不要说话了。”
“咋了？事实还不让人说了？”
“陈先生，你稍等。”
唐诗逸返回。
唐诗潇还在愤怒当中。
“表妹，你从哪弄来的这个乡巴佬？赶快把他赶走，不然，我出手废了他！”
父亲唐仁宗面色同样阴沉。
“诗逸，你今天太不像话了，赶快把那个乡巴佬打发掉，要不然，我也会出手把他废掉。”
“哎，表姐，爸爸，陈楚他医术很高超的，要不然我们在外面等一会儿，如果子轩返回救不回大伯，你们出来找我。”
宋子轩道：“诗逸妹妹，你肯定是被人骗了，等我老师把大伯救活，一定出门把那个骗子打成残废！”
唐诗逸返回车上。
她现在的心情很复杂。
有些担忧的看着陈楚。
“陈先生，要不然你逃跑吧。”
陈楚笑了：“我跑啥？”
“陈先生，如果你不跑，一会儿大伯被抢救过来，他的脾气更加暴躁，到时候我怕拦不住他们，趁现在……”
正说着，门开了。

唐诗潇焦急道：“表妹，你带来的那个医生呢？”
“表姐，我希望你得饶人处且饶人。”
“唉，表妹，你说什么呢？我爸爸真的快不行了，那个该死的宋子轩，带来的老师根本不管用！”
她简单的把情况说了一下。
就在刚才，强心针打了进去。
三分钟后，唐义宗大口喘息，呼吸困难，马上要窒息而亡，而且任何抢救办法都不管用。
这才想起打强心针之前，陈楚说的话。
跑出来找人。
“你快和我进去救我爸爸！”
陈楚打了个哈欠。
“不好意思，我不是一块砖，想用的时候随时搬！”
“可是，你明明是表妹找来给我爸爸看病的啊？”
“呵呵，但你们对我百般刁难，万般怀疑，把我当成跳梁小丑，这个病我不看也罢！”
“你……”忽然，唐诗潇掏出手枪，指着陈楚的头。
“再问你一句，进不进去给我爸爸看病？”
“呵呵，这就是你们唐家的礼仪？我告诉你，打死我也没用！我意已决！”
陈楚体内运转欢喜鏖战功法，他有信心，可以在她开枪瞬间，躲避过去。
“好吧。”唐诗潇咬了咬牙。
“我求你还不行么？你要什么条件才可以给我爸爸看病？五百万够吗？一千万？还是多少钱？你说个数字。”
“和钱没关系！”

“那我呢？我以身相许可以么？”唐诗潇几乎从牙缝里挤出了这句话，眼中已经蓄满了水雾。
陈楚这才正视的看着她。
体内的欢喜鏖战功法翻转起来。
难道……这个女人也是十二道精气之一？要不然欢喜功法不可能这样活跃的。
“唐小姐，我答应救你父亲，但是看在你一片孝心的份上。”

;;
"Shut up!" Tang Shixiao's face was cold, her fists were clenched, and there was a thin layer of something that looked like mist on the surface of the fist wind.
Tang Shiyi immediately pulled Chen Chu out.
"Mr. Chen, please stop talking."
"What's wrong? The truth hasn't been told yet?"
"Mr. Chen, please wait a moment."
Tang Shiyi returns.
Tang Shixiao was still angry.
"Cousin, where did you get this country bumpkin? Drive him away quickly, or I will destroy him!"
His father, Tang Renzong, looked equally gloomy.
"Shiyi, you are so shameful today, get rid of that country bumpkin quickly, otherwise, I will also take action to destroy him."
"Hey, cousin, dad, Chen Chu has very good medical skills. Otherwise, we wait outside for a while. If Zixuan comes back and cannot save the uncle, you come out and find me."
Song Zixuan said: "Sister Shiyi, you must have been deceived. When my teacher saves your uncle, he will definitely go out and beat that liar into a cripple!"
Tang Shiyi returned to the car.
She feels very complicated now.
He looked at Chen Chu worriedly.
"Mr. Chen, why don't you run away."
Chen Chu smiled: "Why should I run?"
"Mr. Chen, if you don't run away, my uncle will be rescued later and his temper will become even more violent. I'm afraid I won't be able to stop them by then, so now..."
Just as he was talking, the door opened.
Tang Shixiao said anxiously: "Cousin, where is the doctor you brought?"
"Cousin, I hope you will be merciful and merciful."
"Hey, cousin, what are you talking about? My father is really dying, and that damn Song Zixuan, the teacher he brought here is useless at all!"
She briefly explained the situation.
Just now, a shot in the arm was given.
Three minutes later, Tang Yizong gasped for breath, had difficulty breathing, and was about to suffocate to death, and no rescue methods worked.
Only then did he remember what Chen Chu said before taking the shot.
Run out and find someone.
"Come in with me and save my dad!"
Chen Chu yawned.
"Sorry, I'm not a brick. I can move it whenever I want!"
"But you were obviously brought here by your cousin to treat my father, right?"
"Haha, but you are making things difficult for me, doubting me, and treating me like a clown. I don't care if I don't treat this disease!"
"You..." Suddenly, Tang Shixiao took out a pistol and pointed it at Chen Chu's head.
"Let me ask you again, can you go in to see my father?"
"Haha, is this the etiquette of your Tang family? Let me tell you, beating me to death is useless! I have made up my mind!"
Chen Chu's body was full of joyful fighting skills, and he was confident that he could dodge the moment she fired.
"Okay." Tang Shixiao gritted her teeth.
"Can't I just beg you? What conditions do you need to treat my father? Is five million enough? Ten million? Or how much? Just give me a number."
"It has nothing to do with money!"
"What about me? Can I agree with you?" Tang Shixiao almost squeezed out these words through her teeth, her eyes already filled with mist.
Only then did Chen Chu look at her squarely.
The joyful fighting skills in the body turned over.
Could it be that...this woman is also one of the twelve spirits? Otherwise, the Huanxi technique would not be so active.
"Miss Tang, I promised to save your father, but for the sake of your filial piety."
